question: Can you describe God?
answer:
God is the Giver of life [cdad6eaa77d2a85e], and God loves you [e8775eb6bb80b58a]. The Father is greater [9b18f46fa9b7eb3e], and as Creator He has perfect faith in His creations because He created them [919b31be6a7b9305]. In creation, God projected His Creative Ability from Himself to the Souls He created, and imbued them with the same loving will to create [ac36cabb548625fc]. Love is everything [4168538feef0d380].

These claims also point to why describing God is difficult. God belongs to the realm of knowledge, not perception: knowledge is timeless [1c6ca9f8d125db0d], while perception is merely temporary [8a4ddb42986da1d4], and only the Oneness of knowledge is conflictless [3420d0187622a6e6]. Applied to your question, this is my own reading: because God is known rather than perceived, what we can offer here is less a definition than what He gives and extends -- life, love, the creative ability shared with His creations -- rather than a full account of His nature.

These passages show God through what He gives and through the distinction between knowledge and perception; they don't give us enough to describe His nature more fully or directly.

question: What does the Course say a miracle worker does?
answer:
A miracle worker is one who accepts a particular kind of denial and projection -- the denial of errors and the projection of the affirmation of truth -- uniting these abilities and imposing them back on himself and others [95eaa50303ea9c1b]. For this to work, the miracle worker must be in his right mind; otherwise he cannot reestablish right-mindedness in someone else [3e70ef2d6210620e].

The miracle itself is a service -- the maximal service one person can render another [17eac7c1eda0df74]. The power to work miracles belongs to you, and the Atonement is its purpose [1910b050bd79821d]. Miracles are teaching devices for demonstrating that it is more blessed to give than to receive, and they simultaneously increase the strength of the giver and supply strength to the receiver [f1a4499213120458].

Since healing is the result of the miracle [a3c6653d355acf00], and all healing is the release from fear -- which means you cannot be fearful yourself to undertake it [a3c6653d355acf00], this points toward why right-mindedness in the worker matters: the miracle's purpose is to restore the receiver to his right mind, and the worker must already stand there himself [3e70ef2d6210620e]. (That connection is my own reading drawn across these teachings, not a single statement.)

These passages describe the miracle worker's inner condition and function fairly fully; they say less about the specific day-to-day practice of the work beyond this.

question: What is the Atonement?
answer:
The Atonement is the Purpose [1910b050bd79821d], and its purpose is to restore everything to you — or rather, to restore it to your awareness [dc3c40b13cf5e943]. It is THE remedy [b385e07ab930fc06]. "Atoning" really means "undoing," and the undoing of fear is an essential part of the Atonement value of miracles [a49682f9ca9aa6ee].

The teaching surrounds the Atonement with the work that belongs to it. Forgiveness is an empty gesture unless it entails correction [bb8dd5cfa83202da]. Correction belongs only at the level of the mind, and it is a matter of your will [07f1f3225efe96ba][74587a488f61f27f]. Salvation is nothing more than "right-mindedness" [82839d0dd037a9c0], and it depends on disinhibiting the Call of God that has been repressed [acab9397fd6560f0]. Those who are forgiven forgive in return [85e9a97cd188972c].

Applied to your question, these point toward the Atonement as the undoing and correction of fear and error, carried out at the level of the mind — but that connection across these teachings is my own reading. What's here shows the Atonement by its purpose and its work rather than giving a single complete definition of its nature.

question: What is the ego?
answer:
The ego is a man-made attempt to perceive yourself as you wished to be, rather than as you are [9f178f8b19409ac1]. It belongs to the realm of what you have made rather than what you are — the self you made, reacted to with a kind of love and protection, though the deeper question is not how you respond to the ego but what you believe you are [99889442ed8d213c].

The ego depends on the specific [4ed350b2b65dad8f], and the part of the mind that believes in it is the part that believes your existence means you are separate [4ed350b2b65dad8f]. It is bound up with the belief in separation itself [196c17c8dcb41038]. And of all that you might feel, only the ego can experience guilt — when you feel guilty, the ego is in command [61d2aae6cbfaecf8].

question: What is the mind?
answer:
The mind is naturally abstract [4ed350b2b65dad8f], and there is only one mind [0ec7063db717ac05]. When it elects to, the mind becomes a medium by which the Soul creates along the line of its own Creation [68d854b5e507e7c9].

The mind can split. When it does, part of it becomes concrete, and that concrete part is the same part that believes in the ego and that your existence means you are separate [4ed350b2b65dad8f]. The ego is a device for maintaining this belief in separation [3deb7e322787da14]. Yet the mind can be changed: when you commend your Spirit into the hands of your Father, the mind awakens from its sleep and remembers its Creator [d813e5f31f71e596].

The mind can be right-minded or wrong-minded. Right-mindedness applies to the state of mind which induces accurate perception [3f89726f1274c054], and right-mindedness is itself healing [729944925028320a].

These show the mind in its functions -- as a medium of creation, as capable of splitting into ego-belief, and as capable of correction and awakening. Taken together they point toward the mind as the level where change and healing happen, though they describe it more by what it does than by giving a single definition of what it is.

cited_claims.evidence_context: The mind, if it elects to do so, becomes a medium by which the Soul creates along the line of its own Creation. If it does not freely elect to do so, it retains its creative POTENTIAL, but places itself under tyrannous rather than genuinely authoritative control. As a result it imprisons, because such are the dictates of tyrants.To change your mind means to place it at the disposal of TRUE Authority.

cited_claims.evidence_context: Withdrawal is properly employed in the service of withdrawing from the meaningless. It is NOT a device for escape, but for consolidation. There IS only one mind.

cited_claims.evidence: mean that the thought has no effect
cited_claims.evidence_context: On the other hand, many other expressions clearly illustrate the prevailing LACK of awareness of thought-power. For example, you say, “Just an idle thought,” and mean that the thought has no effect. You also speak of some actions as “thoughtless,” implying that if the person had thought, he would not behave as he did.While expressions like “think big” give some recognition to the power of thought, they still come nowhere near the truth.You do not expect to grow when you say it, because you do not really think that you will.

cited_claims.subject: God
cited_claims.evidence: what you have thought that God would NOT have thought
cited_claims.evidence_context: We have said that you cannot change your mind by changing your behavior, but we have also said, and many times before, that you CAN change your mind. When your mood tells you that you have chosen wrongly, and this is so whenever you are not joyous, then KNOW this need not be. In every case you have thought wrongly about some Soul that God created, and are perceiving images your ego makes in a darkened glass. Think honestly what you have thought that God would NOT have thought, and what you have NOT thought that God would have you think. Search sincerely for what you have done and left undone accordingly, and then change your minds TO THINK WITH GOD’S.

cited_claims.subject: Son of God
cited_claims.evidence: The Son of God IS part of the Holy Trinity
cited_claims.evidence_context: NOTHING can prevail against a Son of God who commends his Spirit into the hands of his Father. By doing this, the mind awakens from its sleep and remembers its Creator. All sense of separation disappears, and level confusion vanishes. The Son of God IS part of the Holy Trinity, but the Trinity Itself is ONE. There is no confusion within Its levels because they are of One Mind and One Will. This Single Purpose creates perfect integration and establishes the peace of God.Yet this Vision can be perceived only by the truly innocent.

cited_claims.subject: Christ
cited_claims.evidence: for Christ is the Son of God
cited_claims.evidence_context: The first coming of Christ is just another name for the creation, for Christ is the Son of God. The SECOND coming of Christ means nothing more than the end of the ego’s rule over part of the minds of men, and the healing of the mind. I was created like you in the first, and I have called you to join with me in the second. If you will think over your lives you will see how carefully the preparations were made. I am in charge of the Second Coming, and my judgement, which is used only for protection, cannot be wrong because it NEVER attacks. YOURS is so distorted that you believe I was mistaken in choosing you. I assure you this is a mistake of your egos. Do NOT mistake it for humility.

cited_claims.subject: Creation
cited_claims.evidence: The Creation IS whole
cited_claims.evidence_context: “God is not mocked” is not a warning, but a reassurance on this point. God WOULD be mocked if any of His Creations lacked holiness. The Creation IS whole, and the mark of wholeness is holiness.

cited_claims.subject: creation
cited_claims.evidence: the level where creation is possible
cited_claims.evidence_context: You do not need guidance EXCEPT at the mind level. Correction belongs ONLY at the level where creation is possible. The term does not mean anything at the symptom level, where it cannot work. The correction of fear IS your responsibility. When you ask for release from fear, you are implying that it is not. You should ask, instead, for help in the conditions which have brought the fear about. These conditions ALWAYS entail a separated mind willingness. At that level, you CAN help it. You are much too tolerant of mind wandering, thus passively condoning its miscreations. The particular result does not matter, but the fundamental error DOES. The correction is always the same. Before you will to do anything, ask me if your will is in accord with mine. If you are sure that it is, there will BE no fear.

cited_claims.evidence: The ego is a device for maintaining this belief
cited_claims.evidence_context: You CANNOT escape from the ego by humbling it or controlling it or punishing it. Remember that the ego and the Soul DO NOT KNOW each other. The separated mind cannot maintain the separation EXCEPT by dissociating. Having done this, it utilizes repression against all truly natural impulses, not because the EGO is a separate thing, but because you want to believe that YOU are. The ego is a device for maintaining this belief, but it is still only your willingness to use the device that enables it to endure.

cited_claims.evidence_context: The healer who relies on his OWN readiness is endangering his understanding. He is perfectly safe as long as he is completely unconcerned about HIS readiness, but maintains a consistent trust in MINE. If your miracle working propensities are not functioning properly, it is ALWAYS because fear has intruded on your right-mindedness, and has literally upset it (or turned it upside-down). All forms of not-right-mindedness are the result of refusal to accept the Atonement FOR YOURSELF. If the miracle worker DOES accept it, he places himself in a position to recognize that those who need to be healed are simply those who have not realized that right-mindedness IS healing.

cited_claims.subject: term “right-mindedness”

cited_claims.evidence_context: Right-mindedness is not to be confused with the KNOWING mind because it is applicable only to right perception. You can be right-minded or wrong-minded, and even this is subject to degrees, a fact which clearly demonstrates a lack of association with knowledge. The term “right-mindedness” is properly used as the CORRECTION for “wrong-mindedness,” and applies to the state of mind which induces accurate perception. It is miraculous because it HEALS misperception, and this is indeed a miracle in view of how man perceives himself.
